decision.reason: [ev-eacfddf95197] says only that prometheus-operator "requires Kubernetes >= v1.16.0" because it uses apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 CRDs. It does not say what happens on an older cluster: whether the install or upgrade fails, the CRDs are rejected, or something else. It also does not show that this requirement is new in 0.86.0. The proposal's claim that the upgrade "will fail", and its critical severity, are inferences the evidence does not state, and the validators were all inconclusive. The rendered diffs [ev-f240b6ac3b67][ev-83fc26f44be6] only show Alertmanager and Prometheus version bumps and say nothing about this requirement; deciding the consequence needs evidence of what fails on Kubernetes < v1.16.0 and whether the minimum version changed in this release.
